data.heading: From idea to live in three steps

items.label: 1. Tell us your goals
items.title: Share what you want to achieve in a 20-minute call
items.text: We listen first, then outline what success looks like for you.

items.label: 2. Approve the plan
items.title: A clear plan and a fixed price
items.text: Receive timelines, deliverables and a fixed quote within two days.

items.label: 3. We build and launch
items.title: Watch it come together
items.text: Follow progress in a shared board and go live on the date we agreed.
